column1: # Read from each trial's own before.json inside collected.tar, captured on the lab unit before the
# trial swapped anything. "desktop UMD" and "system ICD" are the registered desktop Direct3D
# user-mode driver file and the registered Vulkan ICD, not a statement about which of them the
# compositor loaded: the last column lists what DWM actually had mapped. The D3D12 triplet of
# each trial is in supervisor-NNN.json under "artifacts". The clock column is the idle operating
# point before the session; DPM raises it under load.
